title: alchemilla pubescens subvar. plicata
intro: Alchemilla pubescens subvar. plicata, commonly known as the alpine lady's mantle, is a type of flowering plant in the buckwheat family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, menstrual cramps, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of alpine lady's mantle are believed to be due to its astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe and protect the skin and mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of alpine lady's mantle include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
